_: One-off amounts a manager owes a tester, on top of the weekly testing pay. Jerry adds a row here when he sends a manager money to hand on. The manager's page adds it to what that tester is owed and says what it is for; recording the payment clears it like any other. A manager's own row is paid to themselves and ticked off the same way. Jerry writes this file, not the managers.
